# 207 Studio: full reference

> https://207studio.dev · support@207studio.dev · South Korea.

{{products}}## Pairy: Connecting Devices (iOS/iPadOS app)

https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815584225 - remote desktop for your tablet. Free on the App Store with no subscription (an optional in-app tip unlocks nothing); the Mac companion is a free notarized download.
Page: https://207studio.dev/pairy/ (how it works, screenshots, the Mac companion download)

{{downloads}}- [Ttoryeot](https://207studio.dev/#ttoryeot): free desktop app for macOS 12 or later (Apple silicon and Intel), notarized with Developer ID, at https://github.com/207studio-oss/ttoryeot-desktop/releases/tag/v0.2.0. Opens HWP and HWPX files as tabs and changes short text in HWPX on the page. Windows 10/11 installers (x64, not code-signed yet); Linux has the command-line tool only.

## In development

- [Chalkieboard](https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/) (초키보드): an iPad lesson board app for elementary school teachers. Board writing with subject tools, PPTX and HWP lesson files opened in the app, and AirPlay to the classroom display. No personal data is collected during class. In beta on TestFlight. Support: https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/support/ · Tester guide: https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/beta/
- CheckyBoard: a Windows app for checking paper exams one question at a time. The teacher marks each answer, and the app makes answer sheets, splits scans into per-question boxes, and produces scores, item analysis and report cards.
- [StoneWars](https://207studio.dev/stonewars/): five in a row on a 15×15 board in 3D for iPhone, with eight stone classes. Play against the built-in AI; more modes are being added. In development.
